frozen_by: Logic Matrix MCP × DSRS Architecture Decision v0.1, Phase A
purpose: Canonical, verified identity of the embedding space that ALL existing DSRS-v1 corpus vectors (document-level and chunk-level) live in. Any server-side query encoder built for the MCP must reproduce this exact space -- same model, same instruction, same normalization, same inference precision -- or cosine similarity against the existing Vectorize-migrated corpus vectors is meaningless (see architecture decision doc §1.2, §30 principle 2).
query_prefix: 为这个句子生成表示以用于检索相关文章：

score_postprocessing.purpose: Raw BGE cosine is NOT a fixed-threshold confidence value (BGE's own model card: >0.5 does not mean similar). The existing browser DSRS applies a corpus-CALIBRATED linear floor/ceiling rescale before the raw cosine is usable as a ranking signal. A server-side retriever that skips this and feeds raw cosine into rank fusion will rank differently than the browser does today.
score_postprocessing.formula: score = 0 if raw<=floor; 1 if raw>=ceiling; else (raw-floor)/(ceiling-floor)
score_postprocessing.calibrated_against: 1881-document corpus sample, spread of queries from clearly-unrelated (~0.47-0.48 best-match ceiling) to deeply-covered topic (~0.68 for genuinely on-topic Riemann Hypothesis hits)
score_postprocessing.caveat: Calibrated when the corpus had ~1881 documents; not re-validated at the current 2676-document scale. Worth re-checking before treating it as permanent.

verified_2026-08-15.method: Direct empirical check against the real generated artifacts, not just trusting manifest claims or the architecture decision doc's prose.
checks: scripts/build_embeddings.py: MODEL_NAME/ONNX_MODEL_NAME/DIM/QUERY_INSTRUCTION constants match this profile exactly
scripts/build_chunk_embeddings.py: same constants, confirmed identical to document-level
shell/public/semantic/semantic-vector.js: browser query encoder uses the same model name, same query_instruction (read dynamically from vectors.meta.query_instruction), q8 quantized inference
registry/generated/embeddings.f32.bin: 5 randomly-sampled document vectors all measured L2 norm = 1.000000 (genuinely normalized, not just claimed)
registry/generated/chunk-embeddings.f32.bin: 3 randomly-sampled chunk vectors all measured L2 norm = 1.000000
discrepancies_found_vs_architecture_doc: inference_dtype_browser (q8 quantized) was not captured in the architecture decision doc's §7.2 schema -- added here. A server-side encoder using fp32 for the 'same' model may produce vectors that are close but not identical to the browser's; Phase C's golden-vector test (cos->1) should catch this, but the server implementation should default to q8 to minimize drift rather than relying on the test to catch it after the fact.

score_postprocessing (the floor/ceiling rescale) was not captured in the architecture doc at all. Reproducing only the embedding SPACE (model/dim/instruction) is necessary but not sufficient to reproduce the browser's actual RANKING behavior -- the rescale is part of what makes today's DSRS results look the way they do.

migration_note: Any future profile (dsrs-v1.1, dsrs-v2, ...) that changes model, tokenizer, dimension, normalization, query instruction, document instruction, chunking policy, or score_postprocessing must get its own profile_id and its own file in this directory -- never overwrite this one. See architecture decision doc §7, §19-21 (DSRS-v2 must be a shadow index, benchmarked, never silently promoted).
